interpretation.absence: No association means no match in this bounded selection, not mathematical nonmembership. Unknown/uninspected qualities are not negative tags.
interpretation.certificate: All of that certificate's directed requests and explicit certificate dependencies must be witnessed; alternative routes never supply missing requests to each other.
interpretation.clocks: Witness stages use the positive-spine clock; spiral iteration and raw normalization scale remain separate parameters. Bundle completion is not a causal execution trace or a minimum over all proofs.
interpretation.identity: Repeated roles may share retained occurrences. Certificate counts and empty overlap do not establish independent evidence.
interpretation.membership: Exact arithmetic in the selected external families.
interpretation.node_scope: Public node observations are scoped to the checkpoint. saved_source_node preserves the full source record; confirmation_threshold is a schedule, not an observed event.
interpretation.partial: No named certificate is complete, but at least one has some supporting requests or dependencies.
interpretation.snapshot: Queries read this saved snapshot; they do not silently recompute against a changed or missing source.
interpretation.spiral: A witnessed scalar lineage does not require the later direct target-shell certificate; complex multiplication remains an external interpretation.
interpretation.unwitnessed: No named certificate has supporting witnesses; mathematical membership remains exact.
interpretation.witnessed: At least one named certificate is complete. Inspect its criterion; this does not assert a literal fractional-input edge.
